dialogues.jp: 「ふあ〜」
dialogues.en: I turned the alarm clock off, and stared at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I turned the alarm clock off, and stared at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 早く起きるとまだ眠い。
dialogues.en:
I woke up, although I wanted to sleep a little more. That's
how I was feeling. I couldn't go back to sleep even when I
closed my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I woke up, although I wanted to sleep a little more. That's
how I was feeling. I couldn't go back to sleep even when I
closed my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 冬はやっぱり布団が恋しいよな。
dialogues.en: "......So tired."
dialogues.text: "......So tired."

dialogues.jp: 『春眠暁を覚えず』って言葉もあるが……。
dialogues.en: I got out of bed, got dressed, and went downstairs.
dialogues.text: I got out of bed, got dressed, and went downstairs.

dialogues.jp: 夏は暑さでだるくなるし。
dialogues.en: "What's wrong with you!?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong with you!?"

dialogues.jp: 秋は……睡眠の秋？
dialogues.en: Nemu was eating a pastry in the living room.
dialogues.text: Nemu was eating a pastry in the living room.

dialogues.jp: ……結局、一年中眠い気がする。
dialogues.en: "Nothing. I just got up on time."
dialogues.text: "Nothing. I just got up on time."

dialogues.en: It's not that surprising.
dialogues.text: It's not that surprising.

dialogues.jp: 寝る子は育つ、だな。
dialogues.en: "But you usually can't do that."
dialogues.text: "But you usually can't do that."

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、せっかく早く目が覚めたんだし、起き
　るか）
dialogues.en:
"It would be so much easier if you could do that every
morning."
dialogues.text:
"It would be so much easier if you could do that every
morning."

dialogues.jp: 俺は着替えて学校へ向かった。
dialogues.en: I sat down on the chair while Nemu made fun of me.
dialogues.text: I sat down on the chair while Nemu made fun of me.

dialogues.jp: ダラダラと歩いていると、校門前で環に会う。
dialogues.en: "I'll try."
dialogues.text: "I'll try."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様。おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.jp: なんとまあ、爽やかな笑顔。
dialogues.en:
"That would actually be a little sad...... ah, here's your
breakfast."
dialogues.text:
"That would actually be a little sad...... ah, here's your
breakfast."

dialogues.jp: 「うっす」
dialogues.en:
She handed me a bag from the convenience store with a
slightly concerned face.
dialogues.text:
She handed me a bag from the convenience store with a
slightly concerned face.

dialogues.jp: 何がおかしいのか、環は口に手を当てて笑う。
（仕草まで｛みやび／雅｝だな）
dialogues.en:
I looked inside the bag. There were all sweet pastries
inside......
dialogues.text:
I looked inside the bag. There were all sweet pastries
inside......

dialogues.jp: 体の隅から隅まで巫女なんだろう。
dialogues.en:
(......This kind of food reflects the preference of the
person very much.)
dialogues.text:
(......This kind of food reflects the preference of the
person very much.)

dialogues.jp: 笑い方から女の子らしさが漂う。
dialogues.en: I took out a pastry with cream, and started eating......
dialogues.text: I took out a pastry with cream, and started eating......

dialogues.jp: ◆早起きな環◆
dialogues.en: ◆Waking up on time◆
dialogues.text: ◆Waking up on time◆

dialogues.jp: 早起きをして学校へ行くと、校門前で環に会う。
dialogues.en: Nemu was surprised to see me wake up on time.
dialogues.text: Nemu was surprised to see me wake up on time.

dialogues.jp:
巫女は雑用をするため、朝５時に起きていると
言う衝撃的事実を聞かされる。
dialogues.en:
With a slightly concerned face, she said that it would be
much easier for her if I could wake up on time every day.
dialogues.text:
With a slightly concerned face, she said that it would be
much easier for her if I could wake up on time every day.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、絶対真似できない。
